author: cost_peer specialist

coverage.modigliani_miller: Proved the state payoff decomposition and law-of-one-price claim-bundle result under fixed operations, no financing taxes/resource/issue costs, common information and feasible replication. Explicit recapitalization proceeds preserve owner-wealth accounting. Replicating linear pricing is derived from two traded primitive claims rather than inferred from physical means.
coverage.required_returns: Derived the no-tax weighted expected return and leverage identity from dated expected receipts. Distinguished promised defaultable yield from expected debt return and qualified leverage monotonicity to fixed operating/debt returns.
coverage.tradeoff: Original finite one-year tax/refund/default contract prices new debt first, values state tax and incremental distress cash consistently, nets real issue costs and compares only its stipulated menu. Perpetual shield formulas are explicitly inapplicable. Default shortfalls, claimant distributions, resource costs and government transfers are separated.
coverage.agency: Manager/shareholder and shareholder/creditor conflicts are distinct. Fully priced original risk-shifting case separates old-claim changes from prospective loan proceeds; the new-loan face and subsequent shareholder action are jointly checked.
coverage.debt_overhang: Derived equity-funded NPV = project NPV minus gain to old debt. Original case closes all old claims, demonstrates why junior financing alone does not cure it, and values both a conditional creditor-contribution agreement and a consented senior loan.
coverage.information: Original equity-only private-type case rejects an incentive-incompatible pooling candidate and verifies issuing types, conditional investor beliefs, low-type participation and high-type deviation at a separating outcome. Safe debt/internal cash contrasts retain all funding opportunity costs.
coverage.policy: Pecking order, static trade-off and debt discipline are conditional mechanisms; no universal hierarchy, optimal ratio or announcement inference. Covenants, lost opportunities, consent, fees and financing flexibility retain concrete cash/incentive comparisons.

The teaching benchmark reconciles required returns, finite shields and old versus newly priced creditor claims. The distinct delayed project gives total NPV 6, equity-funded NPV -3 and contribution interval [3,9].

validation.result: Numerical determinate results independently recomputed in the focused checker; proof, assumptions, economic interpretations and open-answer criteria manually audited against each full prompt.

source_inspection.scope: Opened actual official MIT PDFs for Capital Structure I, Capital Structure II and Informational and Agency Considerations; read scoped proof, claim pricing, taxes/distress, debt-overhang, creditor anticipation and information-choice sections. Figures/extracted garbled equations are not claimed visually audited; original algebra and all numerical cases were independently derived.
source_inspection.exclusions: No historical return, industry leverage, tax-law, default-cost or announcement-return tables are used as current data. The original 1958 article and a complete original Myers research paper are not claimed inspected; an inaccessible repository download was not included as a verified source.

findings.finding: The initial wording suggested the identity alone establishes increasing equity required return whenever debt return is lower, without holding the debt return fixed as leverage changes.
findings.resolution: Qualified the monotonic comparison to unchanged operating required return and fixed lower debt return, gave the risk-free-debt range as example, and expressly stated that a varying debt return prevents an unconditional monotonic conclusion from the identity alone.

findings.finding: The prospective policy comparison needed explicit claim/funding boundaries and a quantified route to creditor consent rather than assuming a loss-making waiver.
findings.resolution: Specified no initial new securities/distributions/contributions, fees paid by the firm, and shareholder side payments 2/6 to preserve creditor value. Net shareholder gains 6/3 now close to total gains and recommendation requires actual consent/funding.

limitations: Author review is not a separate independent human academic assessment. Coordinator acceptance, shared-source integration and whole-library checks remain pending.
The cases are finite hypothetical contracts; positive valuation weights and internal identities do not establish real financing access, empirical optimal leverage or actual tax/insolvency rules.
The lab checks its stated three-contract menu, two operating policies and explicit private-information candidates; it does not enumerate all financing policies or all possible signaling equilibria.
Real bargaining, enforcement, monitoring and asymmetric information can alter the displayed repairs; consent and implementation are not implied by a positive aggregate NPV.
Visual/mobile/keyboard/print UI QA was not performed.
handoff: Complete bounded author package, with exact final payload hashes and no open author findings. Coordinator alone decides canonical acceptance and publication.
